name: petstore-crud-regression
description: Swagger Petstore v3 CRUD regression with Postman and Newman

scripts.test: newman run postman/Petstore_CRUD.postman_collection.json --environment postman/Petstore.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json,junit,htmlextra --reporter-json-export reports/newman.json --reporter-junit-export reports/newman.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/html/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Swagger Petstore CRUD" --reporter-htmlextra-omitHeaders --reporter-htmlextra-omitRequestBodies --reporter-htmlextra-omitResponseBodies
